notes.title: Update #1.0.7
notes.notes:
Good evening all Garbage players! Hope you are enjoying the hot summer and using your AC, because it's hot out here! Here is some stuff that we fixed!

Updated:

 - NPS's showing but not giving any reward.
 - Possible titan invasion fix. (Hopefully, we can't find a way to trigger it).
 - Graphics settings were not saved - fixed.
 - Sound settings loaded from start, no more loud loading screen.
 - Popup icons over buildings bugs out when destroying buildings - fixed. (Hopefully, we can't find a way to trigger it).
 - corrupted or renamed save files won't crash the game anymore.


P.S. Our team still can't replicate few bugs like:
 - Return of titans timer going backwards
 - Duping NPC's in Garbage Invasion
 - Going through wall while using shower

We would be very happy if any of you that encountered these bugs could send us the playerlog file. That should speed up the problem solving process. Once again, thank you to all the players and active community members!

notes.title: Update #1.0.6
notes.notes:
Good evening all Garbage players! We're bringing you another update that should solve some issues that were reported by the players.

Fixes:
 - Collider 
 - Pathfinding 
 - Minor bugs removed
 - Texts, conversations and location 


Adjustments:
 - Item and skills balancing
 - Reward amount increased in multiple fight
 - % of rare loot increased by 2%

Localizations:
 - Italian updated
 - English updated

Regarding the rare game breaking bugs we would kindly ask the players who encounter them to send their playerlog files to us via Discord. We spent quite a while trying to replicate those bugs and had no success. Sometimes these issues can be caused by drivers and other factors that are not related to the game. By sharing your logfile you will increase our chances to find out what is the real problem and how to solve it quickly and efficiently! 

https://discord.gg/Cu84uf555a

notes.title: Update #1.0.5
notes.notes:
Greetings to all Garbage players! It's been a week since the official launch and we're bringing another update that should fix some previous issues and finally balance out the mid-late game. These changes should balance out the gameplay for every player independently from the difficulty.


[h3]Features:[/h3]
-  UI scaling option in settings menu for larger screens.

[h3]Bugs:[/h3]
-  Titans hp bug fixed.
-  Overlaps in base training equipment.
-  Opening inventory with hotkey [I] is fixed, won't close after clicking on inventory.
-  Consuming shrooms not giving level bug fixed.
-  See future tooltip updated.
-  Remove all negative and positive effects from the character when it dies, so when resurrected he doesn't have them.
- Rain collectors mess with other buildings' descriptions.

[h3]Balancing:[/h3]
- Blood moon balancing. (2x less food need)
- Food growth balancing, chance to grow less vegetables.
- Greenhouse growth boost by 25%.
- Random seeds from drops/quests.
- Garbage invasions will always give loot if won.
- Homeless shelter food prices are much higher now.

Thank you for all the YouTube streamers who helped us with momentarily bug fixes and all the Garbage community for sharing their feedback!

notes.title: Update #1.0.4
notes.notes:
Good evening Garbage players. As promised 1.0.4 update is bringing not only fixes to reported bugs but also some minor balancing that should improve the mid-late game experience. Thank you for all support and feedback, this helps us to deliver updates faster.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
-  Still getting stuck behind bed bug fix.
-  Minor UI fixes & changes.
-  No more buying infinite axes.
-  Exp not gained when winning combat fix.
-  Game speed issues solved.
-  Fixes to gifs not playing. 
-  Character will go back to doing actions after eating food.
-  Exp gain when winning battle fix.

[h3]Balancing:[/h3]
-  Some bosses won't be stunned or exhausted.
-  Experience can be gained to other stats when the main stat reaches 30
-  Experience from shrooms can be gained only on stats that are not level 30 yet.
-  More punishing events after 30 and 60 days.
-  Nerfed see future from 10 sec to 6 sec.
-  Nerfed quad punch.
-  Stun nerfed from 6 seconds to 5 seconds.
-  Nerfed jackets warmth and health bonuses, bit of pants.

[h3]Localization:[/h3]
-  Japanese localization fixes.
-  Chinese localization fixes. (Updated Chinatown political and other controversy dialogs) 
We do apologize to everyone who was insulted and was affected by those

If you find any other issues feel free to join our discord and address the problems in real time, we will make sure to find an easy way out.

notes.title: Update #1.0.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/7faf34058a87516a77dd4f2e774bd377af9517d5.png[/img]

[h3]Good evening Garbage players. We're coming in with another update. Some critical bugs were fixed that might have stopped you from progressing any further or leaving you with one ending option. However many players haven't noticed recent patches so we'll mention them above. Thank you for all your feedback, this helps us to make our updates more responsive faster and effective.[/h3]

[h2]1.0.3[/h2]

- Gates fixed.
- Water collector water is not being used when showering - fixed.
- Plank guy in construction disappears fixed. A few other NPCs issues there were fixed. Should work on older save files.
- Construction worker dancer crashes the game fixed.
- Dying when combat starts doesn't end the game fixed.
- Bleed deals damage after the fight is won fixed.
- Kids don't float anymore.
- Fixed 2x speed in the menu.
- Enemy character position in base invasions spawned in bed fix.
- Issues with save files when quitting the menu / dying solved.

[h2]1.0.2[/h2]

Features:
- x1.5 & x2 time speed options
- Paused time allows you to do actions.
- Hotkeys for selecting bums (1,2,3 etc.).

Changes:
- Fights will always give a reward now, can be super tiny.

Balancing:
- First garbage invasions are slightly weaker.
- More food in Slum bridge & Playground.
- Easy modes are even easier now. (Down to 60%)

Localization:
- Chinese localization fixes.
- Russian localization fixes.

Bug Fixes:
- Fix recruiting characters not taking your money.
- Comics audio now affected by global volume.
- Skill trainers will not duplicate (double stamina trainers etc) anymore when starting a new game.
- Eating multiple foods without restoring satiety bug fix.
- Fix characters getting stuck after combat. (should also work with save files, but might need an additional restart of the game).
- Fix item & skills descriptions shown out of screen on higher than 1080p resolutions. (ultra wide work in progress..)


[h2]1.0.1[/h2]
- 3 game difficulties to make your gameplay less difficult:
- With tutorial: Stat reduction 70%
- Multiple save files: Stat reduction 85%
- No save files: Stat reduction 100% (original difficulty)

- Overall increase of paper income
- Increased chance to obtain consumables and equipable items
- Several minor bug fixes

These are the things we're updated in the last 3 days. Big thanks for the streamers who addressed the issues in real time, that saved a lot of precious time.
Our primary goal right now is to make the game 100% bug free and continue to balance mid-late game resources and fighting system imbalances. If you have any suggestions or critical bugs, please feel free to join our discord server and we will try to solve your issue in real time.

notes.title: Dev log #9 (Final update before release)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/a8c93e6745bb4d2502a041030f249d2770472db7.png[/img]

[h2]Homebased team is bringing some great news and answers to all your questions![/h2]

[h3]First of all we would like to say big thanks to all our active community members. Small things like answering other player's questions, sharing information and your very own strategies really helped us to stay focused on game development. Apes together - STRONG.
[/h3]

[h1]Most important news! Garbage is going to be released on June 4th Friday[/h1]

[h3]It's been a long journey for Garbage, and we are finally ready to share it with the world!
We were working around the clock to deliver the highest quality game and we think the amount of new content will leave you astonished! In the worst possible outcome, the game will not be delayed more than one week.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/9813a0355600ca230d94ab3886b388df262a92dd.gif[/img]

[h2]Updated new screenshots[/h2]
[h3]Our secretive period is over. We tried our best to show the least amount of spoilers while presenting the majority of new features of the game. The new skill tree, classes, events, items, quests, NPC's, you name it![/h3]

[h2]Frequently asked questions to Hobo King:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/1e72e8fc3cadf0ab97de1b1683ebe01c18ca903c.png[/img]

[h3]Q: What is the price of the full game?
A: It was the most difficult decision to make, but our team goal is to make Garbage available for everyone.
The price will be approximately 15 Euro, and we think this price should suit most of the players. However, it could vary depending on the region.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/d89173da84610fb3cabb098321ededeed0d54687.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Will there be any new languages in the game?
A: Yes, we added the Korean translation. In total, Garbage will be translated into 13 languages, and you can check the list in the store page.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/9be48a2f98e8696079e62ec66ba408aa66fd168f.png[/img]

[h3]Q: How can I listen to your game beat-tape?
A: Original soundtrack of the game will be available to purchase via Steam. The beat-tape is greatly expanded since the launch of Hobo Prophecy.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/f2acb98129ea46e1150f13ad5d96a39353dd4cb3.png[/img]

[h3]Q: What about the Steam achievements and cards?
A: Right now we think it is not the most important thing to focus on. If there will be a visible demand for this feature, we will consider delivering it after the official launch![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/ba5e728bea1841bd8c1296a29c51dc13768c671d.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Can I customize and name my character?
A: After long consideration, we came to a conclusion to avoid this feature. First of all It's a management/survival auto-battler and not an RPG-style game. We made sure to compensate for this with a variety of items and fighting classes.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/74707bdaa24a201823d2c0361398b0633c935df3.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Can I play this game online or co-op?
A: Unfortunately, no this is a single-player game with high replayability. However, it might be a feature for the Garbage sequel... Who knows? Maybe even an MMORPG of hobos.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/46ef57fc73127f7cd63e6b897b3ce661f1c6821a.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Can you be a homeless woman?
A: No, we respect women! However, there will be some NPC Hookers![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/96ff2d9c0aae52b903d47bf9a808d0582f8df97f.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Is it going to be as difficult as the prologue - Hobo Prophecy?
A: Great question. Survival - especially during winter and special events, is going to be a bigger challenge. On the other hand the amount of consumable items will provide you with endless options to overcome harsh winter, just be prepared.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/9e67d610e43d4e30d79834aac9b0a96cfd33186c.gif[/img]

[h3]Q: What about the lack of resources and items?|
A: Another great question that seems to bother many players. We added a few new options for looting the areas based on the number of requests we received. In addition, we added more NPC traders, a pawn shop and even a gambling spot![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/55eae82a0e365d290658d38905515d13b3001261.png[/img]

[h3]Q: What is the maximum level of a character?
A: There are always those hardcore players who go to the extremes. That's why we didn't want to limit your freedom and made it possible to level up your skills to 30. However, we will not disclose the level required to finish the main story.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/4f16e6550fe776df2b63feddfd0224ae10008dd8.png[/img]

[h3]Q: Will there be an extended tutorial?
A: If you have never been homeless, you will receive a small tutorial. But let's be realistic - when does anyone who became homeless get a tutorial? You got to figure this shit out by yourself.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37522502/c7db5ac042ab720dc78f05cc2537d3981c6245c5.png[/img]

[h3]Q: When can we see an update for the Hobo Prophecy (prologue)?
A: Right now we are 100% focused on the full game launch. We will update it after the Garbage release![/h3]
